payload.text: CAPABILITY (smile family 1/5 — SABR): fit_sabr is the SABR smile-family calibrator entry — pure (&MarketContext, &MarketQuotes) -> Result<StochasticVolSmile>. Seeds (alpha, rho, nu) from the ATM level, 25-delta risk-reversal skew, and butterfly convexity, then a Gauss-Newton fit reproduces the total-variance anchors; beta is pinned (SABR_BETA). No I/O, no input mutation, no WRITES — the gate self-invalidates if the calibration grows a side effect. One of the five selectable smile families (SABR, raw-SVI, SSVI, Vanna-Volga, parametric).
